title: std::pmr::memory_resource::is_equal
summary: Compares *this for equality with other. Two memory_resources compare equal if and only if memory allocated from one memory_resource can be deallocated from the other and vice versa.
html:
bool is_equal( const memory_resource& other ) const noexcept;
 (since C++17)

Compares *this for equality with other. Two memory_resources compare equal if and only if memory allocated from one memory_resource can be deallocated from the other and vice versa.

Equivalent to return do_is_equal(other);.
